<html:body xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul">
    noMode
    <menulist id="noMode" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="noMode">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"/>
    </menulist>

    filingServers
    <menulist id="filingServers" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="filingServers">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="filing"
                 expandFolders="false"/>
    </menulist>

    filingFolders
    <menulist id="filingFolders" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="filingFolders">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="filing"
                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
    </menulist>

    filingServersAndFolders
    <menulist id="filingServersAndFolders" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="filingServersAndFolders">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="filing"
                 showAccountsFileHere="true"
                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
    </menulist>

    filingSpecials
    <menulist id="filingSpecials" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="filingSpecials">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="filing"
                 showAccountsFileHere="true"
                 showFileHereLabel="true"
                 showRecent="true"
                 showFavorites="true"
                 showLast="true"/>
    </menulist>

    searchServersAndFolders
    <menulist id="searchServersAndFolders" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="searchServersAndFolders">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="search"
                 showAccountsFileHere="true"
                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
    </menulist>

    getMail
    <menulist id="getMail" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="getMail">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="getMail"
                 expandFolders="false">
        <menuitem class="folderMenuItem" label="Static Item"/>
        <menuseparator/>
      </menupopup>
    </menulist>

    newFolder
    <menulist id="newFolder" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="newFolder">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="newFolder"
                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
    </menulist>

    subscribe
    <menulist id="subscribe" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="subscribe">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="subscribe"
                 expandFolders="false"/>
    </menulist>

    deferred
    <menulist id="deferred" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="deferred">
      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
                 mode="deferred"
                 expandFolders="false"/>
    </menulist>

    notDeferred
    <menulist id="notDeferred" class="folderMenuItem" aria-label="notDeferred">
